content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the Apply control on the ir swap screen gives no visible response after the first click, since the cited windows show no navigation, overlay, or error event following the repeated Apply clicks (the next events are unrelated tab/Cashflow actions several seconds later), so users click again at the same spot.", "fix": "Fix: on the ir swap screen, make the Apply control (the span inside the role=\"button\" anchor) disable itself and show a pending state on the first click, and ignore further clicks on it until the request resolves or fails.", "cited_event_ids": ["112", "117", "123", "128", "134", "136:153", "109", "114", "120", "125", "131", "115", "126"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The windows do not show what the Apply control looks like on screen or whether any feedback appears that the event stream does not capture.", "Whether Apply sends a request or what the server returns is not visible in the events.", "A visible error appears on the Counterparty field before Apply is clicked (ids 64:a65, 63:a67, 61:a68); its content and whether it blocks Apply are not shown, so it is not treated as the cause.", "Coverage counts and outcome are taken from the insight facts as given; no abandonment was observed."]}
